title: Adeptus Astartes Geneseed Organ Effects
effects: Betcher Gland
As an Action, make a Ranged Attack at Immediate Range; it deals 2 + SL Damage and inflicts Blinded.
Catalepsean Node
No penalties to Awareness Tests from staying awake for long periods.
Preomnor & Mucranoid
Advantage on Fortitude (Poison) Tests against ingested poisons; reroll failed Fortitude (Endurance) Tests from heat or cold exposure.
Larraman's Organ
As a Free Action, make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test to remove Bleeding.
Lyman's Ear
Advantage to resist Deafened and +1SL on Awareness (Hearing).
Multi-Lung
Triple Toughness Bonus when determining breath-holding time.
Neuroglottis
Advantage on Navigation (Tracking) by scent; tests to detect toxins by taste or smell.
Occulobe
Ignore penalties from Poorly Lit zones.
Oolitic Kidney
As a Free Action, make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test to remove Poisoned.
Sus-an Membrane
Critical unconsciousness causes suspended animation; revival requires Hard (-20) Medicae (Forbidden - Astartes).
Belisarian Furnace
Primaris only: once per session, Hard (-20) Fortitude (Pain) to heal SL + half Toughness Bonus.
